liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out the China Cat into Rider as remarkable, uplifting and the reason for a five-star rating; Reviewer hears a unique groove in this China Cat into Rider [25][27]
- **Mountain Jam** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer calls Mountain Jam awesome, with musicians from all the bands playing together; Mountain Jam, along with Not Fade Away and Johnny B. Goode, featured the Allman Brothers and the Band [2][16]

## Setlist highlights

- **Change is Gonna Come**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [28]
- **Raining in My Heart**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [28]
- **If You’ve Ever Been Mistreated**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [28]
- **La Di Da Day**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [28]
- **Let Me Wrap You in My Warm and Tender Love**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [28]
- **Mountain Jam**: back after 223 archived shows (995 days); rare: 4 archived performances [28]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-07-28.150454.SBD-AUD.composite.t-flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 32 songs; 281 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1973-07-28.135585.aud.cooper.berger.flac16**: audience recording; 31 songs; 271 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1973-07-28.sbd.weiner.181.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 234 min; rated 4.27/5 by 11 [4]
- **gd73-07-28.sbd.weiner.14196.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 27 songs; 235 min; rated 4.11/5 by 56 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the matrix recording's sound quality good; Reviewer finds the matrix sound a little thin [16][27]
- **gd73-07-28.siniawsky-smith.weiner-gdADT11.11474.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 24 songs; 188 min; rated 3.5/5 by 6 [8]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the audience recording better than expected, though undecided about downloading it; Reviewer says the audience recording's quality is mediocre, as if taped on a very cheap deck; Reviewer admits this audience tape isn't the best version but says it documents the event well [23][24][26]
- **gd1973-07-28.152004.SonyStereo.ECM.Moskal.t.flac24**: source not stated; 24 songs; 176 min [9]. Said about its sound: Taper's position near the delayed PA setup gave fairly clear sound [9]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Sam Cutler [1]
- Encores featured the Allman Brothers Band and the Band joining in [16]
- Reviewer arrived late Friday and recalls mud, a mountain of empty water jugs, and miles of walking from the roadside car [19]
- Reviewer paid $10 per ticket for the Dead, Allmans and Band, and heard Friday evening's jam from camp [20]
- Reviewer walked in at 2 AM Saturday, slept about 150 yards from stage, and woke at sunrise amid enormous crowds [20]
- Reviewer hitchhiked in, walked five miles from town, slept within 50 yards of the stage, and woke to Jerry's guitar [21]
- Teens Bonita Beckwit and Mitchel Weiser vanished after leaving Sullivan Co. for this show, a long-unsolved missing-teen case [24]
- Reviewer stresses harsh conditions in the 600,000 crowd; most arrived the day before, making it an endurance test [26]
- The bill ran Grateful Dead first, then the Band, with the Allman Brothers headlining [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-07-28.150454.SBD-AUD.composite.t-flac16**: source: Soundboard Aud Composite [1]. Also: Composite: first source gives both sets and encore unmodified; a remastered second source supplies the finale; a third is pitch corrected [1]
- **gd1973-07-28.135585.aud.cooper.berger.flac16**: taped by Jim Cooper; transferred by Rob Berger; source: source: aud cassette master; taped by Jim Cooper; sony ecm22p’s > hitachi trq-232; [2]. Also: Audience recording with portions patched from Jerry Moore's master [2]
- **gd1973-07-28.sbd.weiner.181.shnf**: transferred by Noah Weiner; source: Soundboard [4]. Also: Audience analog seed tapes from the 1998 Analog Tree were transferred to DAT, enabling a long-delayed digital Watkins Glen tree [4]
- **gd73-07-28.sbd.weiner.14196.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard with audience patches [5]
- **gd73-07-28.siniawsky-smith.weiner-gdADT11.11474.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jeffrey Siniawsky, Joel Smith; source: Audience Recording: Uher mic [8]
- **gd1973-07-28.152004.SonyStereo.ECM.Moskal.t.flac24**: taped by Gerry Moskal *; transferred by Gerry Moskal & Brian Mandel; source: Sony Stereo ECM ->SONY TCD126 Location: ** [9]. Also: Taped by Gerry on a TC-126 with a two-point stereo mic; masters transferred from his reels in the mid-1980s [9]
